metadata.description: A collection of Claude skills and plugins by Eduardo Schroder.

plugins.name: setup-vue-project
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new Vue 3 project and runs all setup sub-skills (scss, zod, axios, docgen, i18n, element-plus, firebase) then installs all rules plugins

plugins.name: setup-scss
plugins.description: Configures Sass/SCSS in a Vue 3 + Vite project — installs sass-embedded, creates global variable partials (colors, fonts, breakpoints) and mixin partials, and wires them into every component automatically via vite.config.ts additionalData

plugins.name: setup-zod
plugins.description: Installs Zod and creates a validated environment variable gateway in src/env.ts — the app throws at startup on missing or malformed config. Also creates .env.example and wires the fail-fast import into main.ts

plugins.name: setup-axios
plugins.description: Creates the typed axios HTTP client module (src/lib/http.ts) with a base URL, auth token interceptor, and error normalisation, plus shared API types in src/types/api.ts

plugins.name: setup-docgen
plugins.description: Installs vue-styleguidist and vue-docgen-api, creates styleguide.config.js, adds npm scripts, and optionally configures GitHub Pages CI

plugins.name: setup-i18n
plugins.description: Installs and bootstraps vue-i18n v9 in a Vue 3 project — installs the package, creates src/i18n.ts, creates src/locales/en.json, wires the plugin into main.ts, and configures the i18n Ally VS Code extension

plugins.name: rules-versioning
plugins.description: Run automated semantic versioning via release.mjs — reads commit history, bumps MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH, updates package.json, prepends CHANGELOG.md, and creates a release commit + git tag

plugins.name: rules-commit
plugins.description: Generates semantic git commit messages based on staged changes with git emoji support

plugins.name: rules-vue-code
plugins.description: Enforces the official Vue.js style guide for naming and structuring Vue components, composables, and code, organized by priority

plugins.name: rules-ts
plugins.description: Enforces Vue 3 + TypeScript Composition API conventions — typed props, emits, refs, reactive state, event handlers, provide/inject, and custom directives

plugins.name: rules-pinia
plugins.description: Enforces conventions for writing Pinia stores with the Composition API — naming, typed state, async actions, getters, persistence, and testing

plugins.name: rules-vue-scss
plugins.description: SCSS coding conventions for Vue 3 + Vite projects — lang="scss" on all style blocks, global variables and mixins, BEM naming, no inline styles, mobile-first responsive design

plugins.name: rules-i18n
plugins.description: Enforces internationalization conventions in Vue.js + vue-i18n projects, compatible with the i18n Ally VS Code extension — key naming, no hardcoded strings, audit missing keys

plugins.name: rules-zod
plugins.description: Enforces Zod usage conventions — always consume env variables through the src/env.ts gateway, never read import.meta.env directly, schema conventions, and testing patterns

plugins.name: rules-testing
plugins.description: House style guide for Vitest unit/component tests and Playwright e2e tests — file layout, naming, Page Object Models, mocking, and auth fixtures for Vue 3 + TypeScript projects

plugins.name: rules-documentation
plugins.description: Enforces JSDoc-style comments on Vue 3 reusable components — component description with @displayName, every prop, emit, slot, and exposed member documented, plus example files

plugins.name: setup-element-plus
plugins.description: Installs and configures Element Plus in an existing Vue 3 + Vite project — auto-import, optional dark mode via VueUse useDark, theming, optional icons, reusable App* wrapper components, and optional auth pages + navigation layout

plugins.name: setup-firebase
plugins.description: Installs and configures Firebase in any TypeScript project — asks which services to enable (Firestore, Authentication, Realtime Database, Storage, Cloud Functions, Hosting), scaffolds typed service modules, and wires Firebase config through environment variables

plugins.name: rules-vue-router
plugins.description: Enforces Vue Router best practices — lazy-loaded routes, file-based routing conventions, Composition API usage, data fetching patterns, and v-slot for transitions and multi-route layouts

plugins.name: rules-client-api
plugins.description: Style guide for structuring API calls — never call axios/fetch in components, typed service modules per domain, composables own loading/error state, typed ApiError from interceptor
